source.title: DeepSeek API Docs — Models & Pricing
source.note: Official published rates. Peak is double off-peak; the page reserves the right to change prices, so re-check it periodically and update this file — the projection derives money at view time, so an edit here takes effect without refolding any session.

peak.description: Peak hours are 01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC, Monday through Friday, excluding Chinese public holidays. Every other hour is off-peak and billed at half the peak rate, including weekends and Chinese public holidays in full.
peak.holidaysNote: Calendar dates in China Standard Time (UTC+8), from the State Council notice on the 2026 public holidays (国办发明电〔2025〕7号); only those after the holiday rule took effect on 2026-09-19 are listed. The next year's notice is published each November: add its dates here then. A make-up working day on a weekend stays off-peak, since the page bills every weekend off-peak. Unlike a rate, the peak rules decide the tier each request is folded into, so a change here reaches past sessions only when the pack's stateVersion moves.

freeBuckets.cacheWrite: DeepSeek publishes no cache-write charge: cached prompt tokens are billed at the cache-hit input rate only.
